feeds.title: Boxing News
feeds.description: Boxing News Magazine is all about the sport of boxing. It covers big fights, rankings, and stories about famous and upcoming boxers. The magazine also gives previews, results, and expert opinions on matches. It's made for boxing fans who want the latest updates and insights on the sport.

feeds.title: Boxing Social
feeds.description: Get the latest boxing news, boxing results, and videos from the UK and the world. Established in January 2017 by co-creators Ryan Fletcher and Jay Robinson, Boxing Social quickly proved itself as a reliable, trusted source for the latest boxing news around the globe.

feeds.description: The Swindon Advertiser (known by locals as 'the Adver') is a daily tabloid newspaper, published in Swindon. Find latest Boxing news from the Wiltshire area, Jamie Cox, Results & Fixtures, team and much more!

feeds.title: The Bolton News
feeds.description: The Bolton News is a daily newspaper covering the towns of Bolton, Horwich, Farnworth and Westhoughton in north-western England. It covers boxing news from England and international matches.

feeds.title: England Boxing
feeds.description: England Boxing is the national governing body for boxing. It is responsible for the governance, development and administration of boxing in clubs and competition. It also represents England as a member of the International Boxing Association (AIBA) and the European Boxing Council (EUBC).
